configuration.evidence: Compare preparation and three transform calls as one real-instruction chain without imposing a rotation identity.
limitations: Branches 139/13A fall through and each table wrapper runs once; other conditional tests default false.
Dispatch entries are independent fixture choices, not datapath-derived.
Only register/Q and checkpoint Y sensitivity is measured; possible external transfers between checkpoints are unmodeled.
One-byte perturbations at two values do not prove independence for every input.

interpretation: Local real-instruction caller fixtures with explicit conditions, table choices and input bytes. Sensitivity is empirical for these perturbations, not recovered I/O or reset coverage.
